description_en: Translate text in an image from one language to another and output a new image that is as faithful as possible to the original
description_zh: 将图片上的文字从一种语言翻译成另一种语言，并输出一张尽可能忠于原图的新图片
kebab_example: aliyun alimt translate-image --image-url https://example.com/example.jpg --image-base64 /9j/4...H/9k= --source-language zh --target-language en --field general --ext needEditorData_:_false_,_ignoreEntityRecognize_:_true --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TranslateImage

parameters.help_en: The URL of the source image. This parameter and Base64 cannot both be empty. Base64 takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 原图 URL，跟 Base64 不能同时为空，优先取 Base64
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded source image. This parameter and URL cannot both be empty. Base64 takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 原图 Base64，跟 URL 不能同时为空，优先取 Base64
parameters.name: image_base64

parameters.help_en: Source language. For supported languages, see Language Reference (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html). This parameter is Required (ignore the "No" listed under "Required" in the table)
parameters.help_zh: 源语种，支持的语种参考 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)，必填（请忽略表格中“是否必填”中的“否”）
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language. For supported languages, see Supported Languages (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html). This parameter is Required (ignore the "No" in the "Required" column of the table)
parameters.help_zh: 目标语种，支持的语种参考 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)，必填（请忽略表格中“是否必填”中的“否”）
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en:
The translation realm. Valid values:
`general`: General image translation
`e-commerce`: E-commerce image translation

By default, or if the realm is not detected, the image is processed as a general image translation
parameters.help_zh:
翻译领域， 可选值如下。
`general`: 通用图片翻译
`e-commerce`: 电商领域图片翻译

默认及未识别领域均按通用图片翻译处理
parameters.name: field

parameters.help_en:
Extension information, in JSON string format. It may contain the following fields:  
`needEditorData`: A string value of `true` or `false`, defaulting to `false`. Indicates whether to return post-translation editor data in the response. This is used only when integrating your own post-translation editor (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2507676.html).  
`ignoreEntityRecognize`: A string value of `true` or `false`, defaulting to `false`. In e-commerce image translation, the system automatically detects whether text appears on the main product entity in the image and skips translation if it does. This field controls whether to perform this detection. It has no effect on general image translation
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息, JSON String 格式，里面可以包含的字段如下。
`needEditorData`: 取值为字符串 `true`/`false`，默认为`false`，是否需要在结果中返回图片翻译译后编辑器数据，仅用于自行接入图片翻译译后编辑器 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2507676.html)时，获取数据使用
`ignoreEntityRecognize`：取值为字符串 `true`/`false`，默认为 `false`，电商领域图片翻译会自动判断文字是否在图片中的商品主体上，如果在，则略过翻译；使用本字段来控制是否进行上述判断，本字段对通用图片翻译无效
parameters.name: ext

Code.description_en: Status code of the request result

Data.description_en: Struct of the image translation result

FinalImageUrl.description_en: URL of the final translated image
FinalImageUrl.description_zh: 最终翻译结果图片 URL

InPaintingUrl.description_en: Background image for the post-translation editor
InPaintingUrl.description_zh: 图片译后编辑器背景图

TemplateJson.description_en: Template data for the post-translation editor
TemplateJson.description_zh: 图片译后编辑器模版数据
